These are two arcade cores - Gyruss and Time Pilot '84. You must provide ROM files in folders on the SD card (NOT ZIPPED - UNZIP THEM). Gyruss supports MAME sets "GYRUSS" and "GYRUSSCE", while Time Pilot 84 supports "TP84" and "TP84A".

Both arcade games are normally vertical - you can rotate them for a horizontal monitor by pressing 0, or one of the shoulder buttons on a SNES pad.

Look in each folder for more details.

If you only care about running the cores, you only need to keep the .PHX files. Everything else is source code.
